title: Grow room part
description: One hardware part in the awesome-grow-room-parts catalogue. One YAML file per part in parts/. The YAML is the source of truth; docs/data.json and the README table are generated from it.

id.description: Stable slug. Never renamed once published - recipes, works_with and the site all reference it.

part_numbers.description: Canonical manufacturer part numbers. Survives vendor listing rot - if every vendor link 404s, this is what you search for.

i2c.description: Required for any part that sits on an I2C bus. Feeds the address collision map.

alternates.description: Every other address this part can be moved to. This is the escape route when it collides.

also_occupies.description: Additional addresses this part ALSO holds on the bus - composite modules carry several chips (e.g. M5Stack ENV.III is SHT30 at 0x44 plus QMP6988 at 0x70). These are occupied, NOT escape routes. Never put an address in both `alternates` and here.

protocol_settings.description: Free text: baud, framing, Modbus slave address, SDI-12 address, SPI mode.

logic.description: Logic-level volts, if different from supply.

band.description: Currency-agnostic magnitude, and the fallback for parts with no observed price. Roughly: $ = under 25, $$ = 25-100, $$$ = 100-500, $$$$ = 500+ (USD-equivalent, indicative).

observed.description: The ONE canonical price: what was actually paid, in the currency it was actually paid in. Do NOT pre-convert and do NOT add a second currency here - other currencies are derived at generate time from data/fx.yaml, so hand-written conversions would drift.

currency.description: Currency of `observed`. Record what you paid. Only currencies present in data/fx.yaml `rates` can be converted for display; others are shown as-is.

source.description: Provenance of `observed`. 'receipt'/'invoice' = a real transaction - what was actually paid, after any trade or negotiated pricing. 'listing' = a vendor's advertised price, not necessarily paid by anyone. 'estimate' = a best guess, and the weakest signal. Budgeting a build means something different depending on which of these you are reading, so say which it is.

unit.description: What one unit of `observed` buys, when it is not simply one item - e.g. 'per 200 m roll', 'per 5.8 m length', 'per metre'. Receipt lines routinely price a roll, bundle or cut length; without this the number misleads.

vendors.description: Several on purpose. A dead link must never kill the entry - part_numbers are the fallback.

ip_rating.description: 'none' means a bare board that needs an enclosure before it goes anywhere near a grow room.

quality_tier.description: Earned from evidence, not opinion. field-proven requires deployment_count >= 3 with the files listed.

deployment_count.description: Number of production device configs with an ACTIVE (uncommented) block for this part. Commented-out blocks do not count.

deployment_evidence.description: The config filenames behind deployment_count. Filenames ONLY - never prose (that belongs in `evidence`), never contents, never credentials.

evidence.description: One or two sentences saying WHY this part sits in this tier. Required: a tier without evidence is just an opinion.

failure_modes.description: How it actually breaks in a grow room. Specific and observed beats generic and safe.

platforms.description: Ecosystems this part is known to work with.

works_with.description: ids of other parts in this catalogue that are known to pair with this one. Validated to exist.

alternatives.description: ids of parts that do the same job. Validated to exist.

image.description: Repo-relative, self-hosted. Never hotlink a marketplace image - they rot. A generated placeholder is fine.

example.description: Copy-paste config. MUST be scrubbed: no API keys, OTA passwords, SSIDs, IPs, MACs or card UIDs.

source.description: Which real config this was distilled from. Filename only.

allOf.comment: An I2C peripheral must declare its address so it lands on the collision map. Host boards and network modules are exempt: they PROVIDE the bus rather than sitting at an address on it.
